purpose: Bounded non-canonical staging for useful first-account provider profile values until the canonical profile/settings owner consumes them.

check_constraints.name: ck_account_profile_bootstrap_chronology
check_constraints.expression_contract: isfinite(created_at) AND isfinite(expires_at) AND expires_at>created_at AND expires_at<=created_at+interval '30 days'
check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

check_constraints.name: ck_account_profile_bootstrap_display_name
check_constraints.expression_contract: display_name IS NULL OR (display_name=btrim(display_name) AND display_name<>'' AND char_length(display_name)<=256)
check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

check_constraints.name: ck_account_profile_bootstrap_family_name
check_constraints.expression_contract: family_name IS NULL OR (family_name=btrim(family_name) AND family_name<>'' AND char_length(family_name)<=128)
check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

check_constraints.name: ck_account_profile_bootstrap_given_name
check_constraints.expression_contract: given_name IS NULL OR (given_name=btrim(given_name) AND given_name<>'' AND char_length(given_name)<=128)
check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

check_constraints.name: ck_account_profile_bootstrap_locale
check_constraints.expression_contract: locale IS NULL OR (locale=btrim(locale) AND locale<>'' AND char_length(locale)<=64)
check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

check_constraints.name: ck_account_profile_bootstrap_nonempty
check_constraints.expression_contract: display_name IS NOT NULL OR given_name IS NOT NULL OR family_name IS NOT NULL OR picture_url IS NOT NULL OR locale IS NOT NULL
check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

check_constraints.name: ck_account_profile_bootstrap_picture_url
check_constraints.expression_contract: picture_url IS NULL OR (picture_url=btrim(picture_url) AND picture_url<>'' AND char_length(picture_url)<=2048)
check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

check_constraints.reason: Reject structurally invalid or impossible persisted state.

state_history.current_binding: Current M5 security state follows the reviewed lifecycle contract.
state_history.chronology: Timestamps encode bounded current security lifecycle rather than a general event log.
state_history.immutability_policy: Identity/ownership fields are immutable unless the M5 contract explicitly permits a bounded lifecycle update.

lifecycle.retention: Retained or purged according to the reviewed M5 durable/ephemeral lifecycle.
lifecycle.redaction: Security identifiers, provider data and verifiers are not exposed outside authorized paths.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Runtime DELETE exists only where the M5 contract defines ephemeral consume/cleanup; durable credentials use logical revocation.

obligations: Real PostgreSQL catalog, constraint, ACL and migration proof for the M5 persistence foundation.
